errors.evidence: On the GSM-8K benchmark, the orange bar for "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" has a value slightly above 80, and the blue bar for "LLaMA-3-8B-it" has a value of approximately 79. Stating the value is approximately 78 for both is incorrect.
On the Chat-Arena-Hard benchmark, the blue bar for "LLaMA-3-8B-it" has a value of approximately 21, not 23.

errors.text_span: Representative values for the models across benchmarks show scores ranging from 23 to 78 for LLaMA-3-8B-it and 30 to 78 for Ours (Iterative RLHF).
errors.evidence: This summary of the ranges is incorrect and based on previously misstated values. The correct approximate range for LLaMA-3-8B-it is from 21 to 79. The correct approximate range for Ours (Iterative RLHF) is from 29 to just over 80.
